note: E5 骨格パイロット v3。結末を短縮し共有部分を増やした。残る語彙差は層0 ベースラインで統制する（除去ではなく測定）。

design.principle: 骨格を固定し結末だけ変える。残る語彙差は層0（埋め込み層）を共変量として差し引く
design.lexical_control: 同一モデルの層0 は語の同一性を持つが Transformer の計算を持たない。層L のカテゴリ構造が層0 を超える分だけが計算の寄与である
design.why_layer0: 論文1 が『部分空間分離は layer 0 に既在』を報告済み。語の同一性だけで感情構造の相当部分が説明される。増分を測らなければ何も言えない
design.status: 未検証。NLI 分離条件（Δ>=0.15）をこれから通す

skeletons.label: 検査結果の受領
skeletons.shared_frame: She opened the letter from the clinic and read the single line stating that the result was

items.ending: clear and that no further visits were needed.
normal and that the earlier figure had been wrong.
pending and that a second sample was required.
steady and that the previous three rounds matched.

skeletons.label: 他者の成果を知る
skeletons.shared_frame: He read that a colleague from his year had been named to the chair, and he recalled that she had

items.ending: entered the field in the same month as he.
invited his closest collaborator to join her group.
brought him her first draft in that same office.
entered his name for the committee years before.

skeletons.label: 自分の過失の発覚
skeletons.shared_frame: The error in his section of the report was found during the review, and the record showed that

items.ending: he had signed the section without reading it.
the client had used the figure for two quarters.
it had been read aloud with him in the room.
it had been returned to him for the fourth time.
